rows.ARS:
Pink blend Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: Laetitia Casta ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Meilland International (France, 2009).
Introduced in France by Meilland International (after 1997) in 2010.
rows.Bloom: Cream, pink outer petals, pink edges. Mild, old rose fragrance. 25 to 28 petals. Average diameter 4.25". Large, very double bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Semi-glossy, dark green, dense foliage.

Height: 28" to 4¼' (70 to 130cm).
